lines.en: My wheels are carved pumpkin. Heavy.
Wooden wheels creak over the grass.
One slow, unhurried roll forward.
The carved face on my shell rocks along.
I keep to the forest path.
Water sloshes inside my body.
A wheel snags on a stone.
I roll slowly over a layer of leaves.
My shadow runs far longer than I am.

lines.zh: 藤蔓从车厢缝里垂下来
lines.en: Vines trail from the seams of my frame.
The axle grinds when I turn.
Two pressed tracks follow me.
Standing still, the flame in my pumpkin flickers.
Wheels stopped. Only a dripping remains.
Water sways gently in my body.
The vines twitch in the wind.
My carved eyes don't move.
I can wait a long time.
Damp seeps from the wood.

lines.zh: 有一片叶子卡在轮辐里
lines.en: A leaf is caught in my spokes.
I smell like rotten wood after rain.

lines.zh: 我停着，看着同一个方向
lines.en: I stand facing the same way.
My pumpkin eye-hollows point at you.
The light at my front flares once.
You're standing too near my wheels.
I slowly swing my front toward you.
Something moves inside me.
No voice. Only the sound of water.
You can't tell what I'm thinking.
My carved mouth hangs open.
I hold still, waiting for you to leave.
My wheels turn half a rotation.
The sound of splitting wood.
A dent sinks into my pumpkin shell.
My vines pull in, then reach out again.
The water inside sloshes harder.
My flame gutters sideways.
My wheels slow by half a beat.
A pumpkin carriage ambles — don't rush me.
Can a thing like me even hurt?
My carved face twists further.
My alchemical axle creaks with pain.
That thing moves. Like something alive.
Even a seaborn's making gets hungry.
A vine extends from my frame.
I need flesh to keep going.

lines.zh: 这在炼金配方里算材料
lines.en: In alchemy, that counts as material.
Approaching slow so you won't startle.
The fire in my pumpkin brightens.

lines.zh: 我的轮子压碎过更大的东西
lines.en: My wheels have crushed bigger things.
The smell seeps in through my seams.
Bring it closer and it's mine.
My wheel hits you. Hard.

lines.zh: 车轮是南瓜做的，撞了会瘪。
lines.en: My wheels are pumpkins; a bump dents them.
I lurch off line.
My vines retract.
My wheel stops right at your foot.
Water sloshes out of my frame.
I don't retreat. I just change course.
Consider that a provocation.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳上多了一道划痕
lines.en: A new scratch marks my pumpkin shell.
Keep your hands out of my spokes.
An alchemical construct has no mate.
I only look for another shell like mine.
Two carriages stopped side by side.
I offer a vine across.
Our frames touch with a hollow knock.
We share the same broth.
No offspring. Only continuation.
A new shell will be built.
Rolling abreast, our wheels clatter as one.
That is our way.
A vine curls around it and lifts.
I stuff it into a seam in my frame.
It drops in with a wet thud.
My wheel rolls over it. Nothing left.

lines.zh: 南瓜车轮碾过去，硬得咬不动。
lines.en: The pumpkin wheel rolled over it; too hard to bite.
Keep it for the next brew.
Two vines pinch it tight.
My carriage holds nothing but pumpkins.
Stowed. No one can see it.
The water inside softens it.

lines.zh: 你动的那一下，我看见了
lines.en: I saw the moment you moved.
My front turns to line up on you.
Every vine stands up.
The water inside begins to churn.
The fire in my pumpkin burns hotter.
No roar. I just roll over you.
My wheels pick up speed.
Can you even back away?

lines.zh: 这东西本来就是用来送东西的
lines.en: I was made to carry something.
Today's trip is a farewell.
Four turns and you're under the wheels.
I'm rolling now.
My wheels press the grass into a lane.
And you heard nothing at all.
Don't stand directly ahead.
Too late to dodge.
I correct my heading onto you.
My wheels turn faster and faster.
Vines drag lines in the dirt.
Where you go, my front turns.
My pumpkin flame lights you up.
Hitting you is only a matter of time.
Trees behind you. No room to dodge.
I roll over a stone and don't slow.
Twenty-odd blocks. I can reach that.
You hear the sound of wood.
And it's getting closer.
I swing my body broadside.
My wheel tracks circle you.
Tightening the circle.
You stepped on my track.
Now. Dead ahead.
I don't need to be fast.
Only that you don't get away.
The water sound grows louder.
The last wheel turn.
A wooden wheel crushes your foot.
My front slams your chest.
A vine lashes out.
My pumpkin shell butts into you.
My axle tears your clothes.

lines.zh: 这一撞不算重，但很突然
lines.en: Not a heavy blow, but sudden.
The hit slides you half a step.
The wheels keep turning.
I rolled over you.
A crack opens in my wood.

lines.zh: 碾碎的东西会留在轮上
lines.en: What I crush stays on my wheels.
Not enough. Again.
A vine snags your ankle.
My body lurches and I veer off.
Something warm spatters my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢倒车，准备第二次
lines.en: I roll back slowly for another pass.
Four turns of reach. Just enough.
This time I won't stop.
When it's done, I roll on.
The road ahead is clear.
A pumpkin carriage stops among the trees.
The flame in my pumpkin rises from dim to bright.
My wheels touch down with a creak.
Vines begin to reach out.
Water shifts inside my frame.
I was built by someone's hands.
No void here. Only trees.
My wheels test a half turn.
The road lies ahead.
I head first toward the darkest way.
The carved mouth slowly closes.
I begin my slow walk.
The wood catches, and the smell is wrong.
I fall, and one wheel comes loose.
Water floods my frame and I sink.
Half my pumpkin shell blows away.
An arrow lodges in the wood.
Even alchemy fears this.
Long unfed. My flame is dying.
Lightning strikes and my spokes char.
There's nothing under my wheels.
